name: Jellyfin
description: Stream movies, TV shows, and personal media from your self-hosted Jellyfin server.

presentation.guestDescription: Sign in with your Jellyfin server URL and account to browse movies, series, and resume watching.
presentation.credentialsDescription: Enter your Jellyfin server URL, username, and password.
